description: Measures /flow-pr-review Step 1.5's haiku-pinned Gatekeeper Subagent's cost-routing accuracy and cost/context footprint against six PR-metadata scenarios covering every documented skip rule and first-match-wins ordering. As pinned, every scenario's child session is haiku, so this pass measures fan-out overhead and triage accuracy only; the cost-routing saving is measured by a second pass per arm run with `--model sonnet` (the CLI override wins over the per-case pin).
